scoreEvidence.fidelity: The superior tip deficit falls from 2.30 to 1.47 mm. The narrow end and adjacent indentation track the raw contours through all three protected sections. Their maximum sampled deviation is 1.28 mm.
scoreEvidence.form: The bent profile and taper persist. The lower shoulder still has a short step. The change in surface finish is modest, especially compared with the previous reverse view.
scoreEvidence.readability: I could trace the long outline on the grayscale scan and confirm it on the overlay. The default oblique view shows only the rounded end beneath the liver. The lower orbit exposes the taper.
scoreEvidence.economy: The exact previous sweep uses 2,136 triangles and 38,480 bytes. r01 uses 1,940 and 34,952 bytes (9% less). The 24-view projected outline deviates at most 0.56 px at 3 px/mm after reducing the smooth surface.
